searchText: ACD call time is very undervalued. In favour of raising the bar and time boxing. Though I wouldn’t want to make EIP editors the bottleneck given we have so few of them. Ideally each client team would have an editor (or agent editors) to help get EIPs merged quickly.

excerpts.author: abcoathup
excerpts.content:
ACD call time is very undervalued. In favour of raising the bar and time boxing. 

Though I wouldn’t want to make EIP editors the bottleneck given we have so few of them. Ideally each client team would have an editor (or agent editors) to help get EIPs merged quickly.
